slug: 2026-02-04 Sudatel-Djibouti Telecom-Ethio telecom launch Horizon Fiber cross-border initiative (SUNA)

facts.fact: SUNA reports Sudatel signed on 4 February 2026 a strategic agreement with Djibouti Telecom and Ethio telecom launching Horizon Fiber, a terrestrial fibre corridor linking Djibouti's submarine cable stations through Ethiopia to Sudan.

systems.owner: Ethio telecom, Djibouti Telecom, Sudatel Group
